name: Transfer In Report
query:
SELECT
    ti.name AS "Transfer In:Link/Transfer In:150",
    ti.transaction_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    ti.company AS "Company:Link/Company:180",
    ti.from_branch AS "From Branch:Link/Branch:140",
    ti.out_reference_no AS "Transfer Out Ref:Link/Transfer Out:150",

    tii.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:150",
    tii.item_name AS "Item Name:Data:220",
    tii.qty AS "Qty:Float:100",
    tii.uom AS "UOM:Link/UOM:80",
    tii.sales_price AS "Sales Price:Currency:120",
    (tii.qty * tii.sales_price) AS "Amount:Currency:120",
ti.transfer_out_location AS "Location:Link/Transfer Out Location:140"
FROM `tabTransfer In` ti
LEFT JOIN `tabTransfer Out Item` tii
ON ti.name=tii.parent

WHERE ti.docstatus<2 and ti.transaction_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s

ORDER BY ti.date DESC,ti.name DESC;
